metadata.description: FORSVN Skills — multi-agent skill stack for research, marketing, product, and meta (process) workflows. 49 skills, single install from github.com/hungv47/meta-skills. Verb-first naming with /forsvn as the front door. Critic-gated agent pipelines with quantitative rubrics, anti-sycophancy mechanisms, and signal-vs-noise verification.

plugins.name: forsvn-skills
plugins.description: All 49 skills across meta (process), research, marketing, and product. /forsvn is the single front door. The plugin is named forsvn-skills and remains distributed from hungv47/meta-skills for URL continuity.

plugins.name: forsvn-preview
plugins.description: Optional review-surface preview for FORSVN artifacts. Renders standard Markdown artifacts into themed HTML previews and captures approve/deny/suggest decisions back into frontmatter. Install alongside forsvn-skills to preview and review artifacts; skills themselves only emit plain Markdown. Ships a /forsvn-preview:review command so agents can list pending artifacts and serve one for a human decision.
